def get_y(x):
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        x0, y0 = pts[i]
        x1, y1 = pts[i+1]
        if x0 <= x <= x1:

    return None

# Integral from 2 to 18 using trapezoidal rule with knot points in between

for i in range(len(all_x) - 1):
    x0 = all_x[i]
    x1 = all_x[i+1]
    y0 = get_y(x0)
    y1 = get_y(x1)
    total_area += 0.5 * (y0 + y1) * (x1 - x0)

result = float(total_area)
